messages:
maria: Heads up team — Prospect Spectral Health asked for a performance POC next Tue. Requirements: mixed workload 60% embeddings (<=128 tokens) + 40% generation (~512 tokens). Goal: sustain 250 qps, tolerate 1k qps microbursts, p95 gen <200ms, embeddings p95 <50ms. They require KMS-managed keys (Azure KeyVault) linked to the workspace. Can SE/ops size and confirm feasibility + a rough hosted pricing estimate?

jon: I can drive. Quick clarifications:
- Deployment: Hosted API initial, right?
- Models: rdx-v2-large primary, rdx-quant-8b as lower-cost variant?
- Region: us-west-2 preferred?

maria: Yes to Hosted and us-west-2. Use rdx-v2-large and include rdx-quant-8b comparison. Keep prefix/KV caching enabled.

jon: Proposed run plan:
1) Warmup/Smoke (10m): KMS passthrough verification, 10 qps to ensure key handshake and caches primed.
2) Warm soak (10m): ramp to 250 qps to stabilize batching behavior.
3) Main soak (30m): 250 qps sustained, capture p50/p95/p99, token counts, GPU util, batch sizes, cache hit rates.
4) Spike tests: 3x 30s microbursts to 1k qps at steady-state to validate graceful degradation and fallbacks.
5) Variant runs: repeat main soak on rdx-quant-8b + compare cost/token and 95th latency.
6) Cooldown and tail-latency capture: gradual ramp-down and a 10m idle to observe cold start characteristics.

I'll cap batch latency at 12ms and enable continuous batching. Will save raw CSV metrics and produce a 1-page summary + latency vs concurrency curve.

ashwin: Infra notes: Hosted + external KMS (Azure KV) adds ~10-30ms on cold start for key fetch and attestation. Recommend a 10 minute warmup before the main soak to avoid skew. For spikes, prime the prefix cache with ~100 unique prefixes so the spike doesn't cache-warm itself mid-test. Also: ensure tenant-level KMS bridge is completed (manual infra step).

elaine: Quick pricing estimate: rough tokens for 30m soak @250 qps with mix => tokens ≈ 30*60*250*(0.4*512 + 0.6*64) ≈ 23M tokens. Hosted rate estimate pending, but quant-8b could reduce per-token billing ~30-40%. Also call out surge billing for microbursts if they exceed baseline quota. I'll prepare a written cost appendix.

maria: Security question: Spectral prefers Azure KeyVault with HSM-backed keys. Is Azure KV supported for Hosted? They flagged HSM attestation as a potential blocker.

ashwin: We support customer-managed keys through our KMS bridge for Hosted; Azure KV is supported but requires inbound peering and a short security review. HSM attestation support is limited — we can accept HSM-backed keys if the customer provisions them and we perform an ops-assisted onboarding. I'll document the onboarding checklist and estimated timeline in the runbook.

jon: I'll schedule a pre-check Wed 09:30 PT to validate KMS linking, scripts, and warmup. Actual run Tue. deploy-bot, can you provision a temp test tenant and reserve the perf slot?

deploy-bot: Precheck scheduled: 1769463720 (Wed 09:30 PT). Bench run scheduled: 1769550123 (Tue). Temp tenant created: spectral-poc-temp-8432. KMS link pending manual infra step.

maria: Spectral confirmed Wed precheck. Also requested deliverables: raw CSVs, 1-page slide with key results, short runbook + KMS onboarding checklist, and a latency vs concurrency curve. They also asked for p99+ heatmap for tokens during spikes.

jon: Acknowledged. Action items:
- Jon: implement k6 + SDK scenarios, include embeddings & gen mix, produce CSVs and slides (today).
- Ashwin: KMS onboarding checklist, warmup script, and infra handoff notes (today).
- Elaine: formal cost estimate with hosted vs quant-8b delta (EOD).
- Maria: confirm any additional compliance docs Spectral needs before Wed.

maria: I'll confirm. One more ask from them: include a short note on fallback policy behavior (if quant variant is used automatically for burst).

jon: Will document fallback policy and how model routing would drop to quant-8b under load. I'll also capture service traces to show routing decisions. Will attach runbook + final CSVs to this thread after run. :thumbsup:
